channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Treasure Coast Residents Report Five Cyclospora Cases Since May
item.description: The Florida Department of Health has confirmed five cases of cyclospora in the Treasure Coast region since May amid nationwide produce contamination outbreaks.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters after hazing investigation involving electric shocks
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District released investigative reports Saturday detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct that led to the termination of 3 firefighters and the suspension of 2 others. item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon at Sebastian as severe weather batters Treasure Coast
item.description: Video sent to WPTV newsroom from Sebastian showed a large waterspout passing over the Indian River Lagoon Friday afternoon. Severe weather stretched from Sebastian to Port St. Lucie and into Okeechobee County.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompt Treasure Coast residents to avoid lettuce
item.description: Confirmed cases of cyclospora have been reported in St. Lucie and Martin counties as contaminated produce linked to Taco Bell locations spreads concern across South Florida.

item.title: Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record with 3:42.66 in London
item.description: Great Britain's Josh Kerr shattered the mile world record Saturday, running 3:42.66 to break Hicham El Guerrouj's mark of 3:43.13 that had stood since 1999.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis join Miami Heat with championship goals
item.description: The Miami Heat introduced Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis Jr. at the Kaseya Center on Thursday, with both players receiving standing ovations from fans.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season on road before home opener October 11
item.description: The Panthers will begin their regular season against the 2026 Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes on September 29 before returning to Amerant Bank Arena for their home opener.

item.title: World Cup Final security ramped up for Sunday's Argentina-Spain match in New Jersey
item.description: The World Cup Final has been designated a Level 1 Special Event with enhanced security measures including a Secret Service perimeter for President Trump's attendance.

item.title: World Cup Final tickets start at $7,700 as demand drives prices to record levels
item.description: The cheapest ticket for Sunday's World Cup Final in New Jersey costs about $7,700 on resale sites, nearly identical to what the median U.S. household earns in an entire month.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent tablets from running artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: JetBlue Cancels Vero Beach to New York Route Less Than a Year After Launch
item.description: JetBlue has discontinued its flight service between Vero Beach and New York less than a year after launching the route.
